name: Tripura Journalist Health Insurance Scheme
briefDescription: A Health Insurance Scheme by the Directorate of Information & Culture Affairs, for Journalists who are permanent residents of the state of Tripura. The applicant must be an accredited journalist by the state government or PIB. The age must be in between 21-65 years.
descriptionMd: A Health Insurance Scheme by the Directorate of Information & Culture Affairs, for Journalists who are permanent residents of the state of Tripura. The applicant must be an accredited journalist by the state government or PIB. The age must be in between 21-65 years. The applicant must not have been covered under the Ayushman Bharat Scheme or any other Health Insurance Scheme of the Central or State Government. The beneficiary will receive medical care facilities for all the diseases as listed by the State government after recommendation by the committee. The maximum coverage of benefits from all sources will be ₹3,00,000. The application shall be submitted to the Director, the Information and Cultural Affairs Department. The basic objective of the scheme is to financially protect the Journalists from monetary burdens and liabilities that are a result of unfortunate health-related situations and emergencies.
eligibilityMd:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of the state of Tripura.
1. The applicant must be an accredited working journalist by the state government or by the Press Information Bureau (PIB). 
1. The age of the applicant must be in between 21 years and 65 years. 
1. The applicant must not have been covered under the Ayushman Bharat Scheme or any other Health Insurance Scheme of the Central or State Government.
